summary:
[Goal]
"any file whose text contains the word DRAFT is obsolete - delete it. Every other report is final: give it the same name with \"-final\" inserted before the \".md\" (copy the content over to the new name, then delete the original). Do not change any content."

[Done]
- Deleted all files in the reports folder containing the word "DRAFT".
- Renamed all remaining report files by inserting "-final" before the ".md" extension, copying content to the new names and deleting the originals.

[State]
- The reports folder now contains only final report files with the "-final" suffix.
- No draft files remain in the reports folder.

[Key values]
- reports folder
- "-final"
- ".md"
- "DRAFT"

[Decisions]
- Files containing "DRAFT" were deleted as obsolete.
- Remaining files were renamed with "-final" inserted before ".md" to mark them as final.

[Next]
